title: 第17章 说好一起光棍到白头你却偷偷生了妞第18章 无耻索要见面礼玉尘出手焚寂剑
lines: 其实林易早就想弄死叶风。
可是他上面的“那位”
却让再等等。
主要叶风现在被玉英真人给盯上了。
这还不到一个月，玉英真人就去戒律院找玉尘子三次了，要求戒律一定要严惩调戏自已女弟子的登徒子叶风。
此事早已经搞的云海宗人尽皆知，若是现在将叶风弄死在石牢里，会在云海宗引起不小的风波。
或许是考虑到影响，或许是担心被人怀疑。
导致“那位”
迟迟没有对叶风下手。
现在褶子了，叶风的师父玉龙上人回山了！
如果在这个时候弄死叶风，玉龙上人就算嫖成脑残，也知道自已徒弟的死必有隐情。
以玉龙上人的性格，以及在云海宗的地位，还不将云海宗闹翻天？
许开道：“林师兄，现在怎么办，要不要放了叶风？”
“不，叶风是因涉嫌监守自盗，以及出言轻薄云师妹才被关起来的。
国有国法，门有门规，就算他是玉龙师叔的大弟子，犯了门规，也须依规处置。
不过既然玉龙师叔回来了，此事还得知会他老人家一声才行。”
顿了一下，林易继续道：“玉龙师叔得知此事后，一定会向戒律院求情的，玉尘子师叔总不会因为一点灵药灵芝，便重罚叶风的，毕竟叶风是玉龙师叔的大弟子，这个面子还是要给的。
我估计叶风很快就会被释放出来。
许师弟，待叶风出来后，你要严密监视，他的记忆没有恢复也就罢了，如果真的有恢复的迹象，咱们必须得有所动作。”
“我明白了。”
许开微微点头，他见林易表情镇定，慌乱的内心也渐渐平复了下来。
两人又密谈了一番，林易便让许开先行返回戒律院，他则要去亲自面见玉龙师叔汇报此事。
玉龙上人居住的地方，位于长老院南面，是一个依山而建的小院落，有厅堂，左右各有两间房舍，一个独立的小厨房，厨房连接着并不算大的饭堂。
虽说这三年，一直有传言玉龙上人已经嘎了，但却始终没有找到尸体或者确切的证据。
这间院子并没有被长老院回收，也重新分配给其他长老。
叶风平日在药圃的工作很忙，又没有达到御空飞行境界，这一年多只回来了两三次。
导致整个院子十分荒芜，杂草丛生，灰尘遍布。
推开已经结着蜘蛛网的院门，看着院内的荒草，玉龙上人微微皱眉。
黄灵儿道：“爹爹，你不是说星罗峰上还有一位叶风师兄吗？怎么这院子看起来已经很久没有人居住过了。”
玉龙上人摇头道：“我也不知道，难道风儿出事了？”
叶风是十多年前玉龙上人在山下捡来的孤儿，二人的师徒感情还是不错的。
此刻看到院内场景，玉龙上人知道自已的大弟子多半是出事了，不禁悲从中来。
这时，一位消瘦老头走了过来。
“哈哈哈，玉龙师兄，还真是你啊，我刚才听弟子说你回来了，还不相信呢！
一去三年，了无音讯，我还以为你死了呢！”
content_en:
In fact, Lin Yi had long wanted to kill Ye Feng.
But the "one" above him
But let me wait.
Mainly, Ye Feng is now being targeted by Zhenren Yuying.
In less than a month, Master Yuying went to the Discipline Academy to find Yu Chenzi three times, asking the Discipline to severely punish Ye Feng, the disciple who molested his female disciple.
Everyone in the Yunhai Sect had already known about this matter. If Ye Feng were killed in the stone prison now, it would cause quite a disturbance in the Yunhai Sect.
Maybe it's because of the impact, or maybe because it's worried about being suspected.
leading to "that"
He has not yet attacked Ye Feng.
Now it’s over, Ye Feng’s master, Master Yulong, has returned to the mountain!
If Ye Feng is killed at this time, Master Yulong will know that there must be a hidden reason for his apprentice's death even if he is mentally retarded as a prostitute.
With Master Jade Dragon’s character and status in the Yunhai Sect, wouldn’t he bring the Yunhai Sect into chaos?
Xu Kaidao: "Senior Brother Lin, what should we do now? Should we let Ye Feng go?"
"No, Ye Feng was locked up because he was suspected of committing theft and making scornful remarks about Junior Sister Yun.
There are state laws and sect rules. Even if he is Master Yulong's disciple and he breaks the sect rules, he must be dealt with according to the rules.
But now that Uncle Yulong is back, it would be better to inform him about this matter. "
After a pause, Lin Yi continued: "When Master Yulong learns about this, he will definitely plead with the Discipline Academy. Master Yuchenzi will never punish Ye Feng severely because of a little magical medicine Ganoderma lucidum. After all, Ye Feng is the eldest disciple of Master Yulong, so he still has to give him this face.
I guess Ye Feng will be released soon.
Junior Brother Xu, after Ye Feng comes out, you have to monitor him closely. It's just that his memory has not recovered. If there are really signs of recovery, we must take action. "
"I understand."
Xu Kai nodded slightly. Seeing Lin Yi's calm expression, his panic gradually calmed down.
The two talked in secret again, and Lin Yi asked Xu Kai to return to the Discipline Academy first, while he went to meet Master Yulong in person to report the matter.
The place where Master Yulong lives is located in the south of the Elder's Courtyard. It is a small courtyard built against the mountain. It has a hall, two rooms on the left and right, and an independent small kitchen. The kitchen is connected to the dining hall, which is not very large.
Although there have been rumors that Master Jade Dragon has died in the past three years, no body or definite evidence has ever been found.
This courtyard was not reclaimed by the Presbytery and was redistributed to other Elders.
Ye Feng is very busy working in the medicine garden on weekdays, and he has not reached the realm of flying in the air. He has only come back two or three times in more than a year.
The whole yard was very barren, overgrown with weeds and dusty.
Pushing open the courtyard door that was already covered with spider webs and looking at the weeds in the courtyard, Master Jade Dragon frowned slightly.
Huang Ling'er said: "Dad, didn't you say that there is a senior brother Ye Feng on Xingluo Peak? Why does this courtyard look like no one has lived in it for a long time?"
Master Jade Dragon shook his head and said, "I don't know either. Could it be that something happened to Feng'er?"
Ye Feng was an orphan picked up by Master Jade Dragon at the foot of the mountain more than ten years ago. The relationship between the two of them as master and disciple was quite good.
Seeing the scene in the courtyard at this moment, Master Yulong knew that something had probably happened to his eldest disciple, and he couldn't help but feel sad.
At this time, a thin old man came over.
"Hahaha, Senior Brother Yulong, it's really you. I just heard from my disciple that you are back, and I still don't believe it!
It's been three years since there was no news. I thought you were dead! "
title_en: Chapter 17 We agreed to be single until old age, but you secretly gave birth to a girl. Chapter 18 Shamelessly asked for a meeting gift, Yu Chen took action with the Burning Silence Sword.
